title: 有機・バイオ機能化学
subtitle: Functional Chemistry of Bio and Organic Materials and Processes
keywords: Functions of organic compounds 2.Functions of polymers 3.Structural analyses 4.Environmentally friendly materials
educationalGoal: This class is will provide knowledge about the design of new materials for a sustainable society. After the class, you will understand the properties and functions of bio-productive materials, such as pigments, oils, enzymes, and polymers. In addition, you will also learn about organic polymers that mimic biological functions.
advice: This course will cover: 1. Functions of organic compounds a. Properties of pigments b. Properties of oils and fats 2. Structural analyses: a. Mass analysis b. Infrared spectroscopy c. Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) 3. Functions and applications of polymers: a. Bio-mimetics b. Green and sustainable chemistry
books: Textbooks:Let's Lean the Polymer-An Introduction to Polymer materials- (kagaku dojin), Fundamentals of Organic Chemistry Japanese 7th edition (Tokyo kagaku dojin) Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of organic chemistry, biochemistry, applied biochemistry, and polymer chemistry are required. Review those concepts in the appropriate textbooks.

activityGoals.body: Explain properties and functions of organic compounds related to living things.
Explain properties and functions of polymers.
Explain how to determine the structure of organic molecules.
Explain properties of environmentally friendly materials by supplying examples.
